IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: TO PROVIDE EMPLOYMENT AND TRAINING OPPORTUNITIES TO PEOPLE WITH DISABILITIES AND OTHER BARRIERS TO EMPLOYMENT.
IRS990.MissionDesc: ORGANIZED AND OPERATED EXCLUSIVELY FOR CHARITABLE AND EDUCATIONAL PURPOSES BY PROVIDING EMPLOYMENT AND TRAINING FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH DISABILITIES AND OTHER BARRIERS TO EMPLOYMENT.
IRS990.Desc: OUR USED GOODS OPERATIONS PROVIDED JOBS AND TRAINING OPPORTUNITIES FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH DISABILITIES AND OTHER BARRIERS TO EMPLOYMENT IN OUR RETAIL STORES, DONATION CENTERS AND THROUGH THE PROCESSING OF DONATIONS. WE PROCESSED 1,401,790 DONATIONS AND PROVIDED OVERALL EMPLOYMENT TO 1,666 INDIVIDUALS APPROXIMATELY 56% OF WHOM HAVE A DISABILITY OR OTHER BARRIER TO EMPLOYMENT.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: OUR MISSION SERVICES DIVISION PROVIDED A VARIETY OF EMPLOYMENT AND TRAINING SERVICES TO THE SAN DIEGO COUNTY COMMUNITY. WE OPERATE CUSTOMIZED EMPLOYMENT SERVICES WHICH PROVIDE VOCATIONAL ASSESSMENT, SKILLS TRAINING AND PLACEMENT SERVICES TO INDIVIDUALS WITH DISABILITIES AND OTHER BARRIERS TO EMPLOYMENT INCLUDING MILITARY VETERANS, YOUNG ADULTS, DEPARTMENT OF REHABILITATION CLIENTS AND SOCIAL SECURITY RECIPIENTS. WE OPERATE SUPPORTED EMPLOYMENT SERVICES WHICH PROVIDE VOCATIONAL ASSESSMENT, SKILLS TRAINING AND PLACEMENT SERVICES TO INDIVIDUALS WITH DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES. WE OPERATE COMMUNITY EMPLOYMENT CENTERS WHICH PROVIDE FREE VOCATIONAL ASSESSMENT, SKILLS TRAINING AND PLACEMENT SERVICES TO ANYONE IN THE SAN DIEGO COUNTY COMMUNITY WHO WALKS IN WANTING SUPPORT. WE PROVIDE LEARNING AND DEVELOPMENT.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: IN DECEMBER 2018 AND 2020, GOODWILL INDUSTRIES OF SAN DIEGO COUNTY ENTERED INTO A NEW MARKETS TAX CREDIT (NMTC) FINANCING AGREEMENT WITH VARIOUS ENTITIES FOR THE PURPOSES OF RECEIVING FINANCING FOR THE ACQUISITION, REFINANCE AND IMPROVEMENTS OF IDENTIFIED REAL ESTATE AND THE ACQUISITION AND INSTALLATION OF ROOFTOP SOLAR SYSTEMS ON VARIOUS PROJECTS.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: SCHEDULE A, PART II, LINE 10, EXPLANATION OF OTHER INCOME:

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THIS REPRESENTS OUR ALLOCATED AMOUNT OF TOTAL EXPENDITURES DURING 2024 FOR CONSULTING FEES PAID TO CAPITAL ADVOCACY FOR THE INTEREST OF VARIOUS GOODWILL ORGANIZATIONS WITHIN CALIFORNIA TO EDUCATE LEGISLATORS FOR THE PURPOSE OF CREATING AWARENESS OF THE SERVICES WE PROVIDE TO THE COMMUNITY AND TO DEVELOP SUPPORT AND OPPOSITION TO APPLICABLE ASSEMBLY AND SENATE BILLS. THE EXECUTIVE STAFF PERIODICALLY HAS DIRECT CONTACT WITH LEGISLATORS, THEIR STAFFS, GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS OR A LEGISLATIVE BODY. THE EXPENSE ASSOCIATED WITH THIS IS NOT READILY DETERMINABLE AS THE CONTACT IS PART OF OUR ONGOING OPERATIONS.

IN ACCORDANCE WITH ACCOUNTING STANDARDS FOR INCOME TAXES, INCOME TAX BENEFITS AND/OR LIABILITIES ARE RECOGNIZED FOR INCOME TAX POSITIONS TAKEN OR EXPECTED TO BE TAKEN IN A TAX RETURN, ONLY WHEN IT IS DETERMINED THAT THE INCOME TAX POSITION WILL MORE-LIKELY-THAN-NOT BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION BY TAXING AUTHORITIES. GOODWILL HAS ANALYZED THE TAX POSITIONS TAKEN IN ITS FILINGS WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE AND THE CALIFORNIA FRANCHISE TAX BOARD. GOODWILL BELIEVES THAT ITS INCOME TAX FILING POSITIONS WILL BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION AND DOES NOT ANTICIPATE ANY ADJUSTMENTS THAT WOULD RESULT IN A MATERIAL ADVERSE EFFECT ON GOODWILL'S CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL CONDITION, CHANGE IN NET ASSETS OR CASH FLOWS. ACCORDINGLY, GOODWILL HAS NOT RECORDED ANY RESERVE OR RELATED ACCRUALS FOR INTEREST AND PENALTIES FOR UNCERTAIN INCOME TAX POSITIONS AT YEAR-END 2024. GOODWILL'S U.S FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAX RETURNS PRIOR TO FISCAL YEARS 2021 AND 2020, RESPECTIVELY, ARE CLOSED. MANAGEMENT CONTINUALLY EVALUATES EXPIRING STATUTES OF LIMITATIONS, AUDITS, PROPOSED SETTLEMENTS, CHANGES IN TAX LAW AND NEW AUTHORITATIVE RULINGS. MANAGEMENT IS NOT AWARE OF ANY PENDING REVIEWS OR EXAMINATIONS.

THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETS ANNUALLY TO CONSIDER THE COMPENSATION OF THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER AND OTHER OFFICERS WITH CONSIDERATION TO COMPARABLE COMPENSATION DATA, RANKING AMONG GOODWILL ORGANIZATIONS, SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITY, EXPERIENCE AND PERFORMANCE.
THE ORGANIZATION USES CARS TO ACCEPT VEHICLE DONATIONS AND ADMINISTER THE PROCEEDS TO THE ORGANIZATION AFTER A SALES FEE TO CARS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER AND THE CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER (CONTROLLER) OF GOODWILL INDUSTRIES OF SAN DIEGO COUNTY ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE TIMELY PREPARATION OF THE FORM 990 WHICH IS PROVIDED TO THE BOARD TREASURER FOR REVIEW. THE CONTROLLER PROVIDES EXPLANATIONS AS NEEDED. THE FORM 990 IS PROVIDED TO ALL BOARD MEMBERS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND EXECUTIVE EMPLOYEES ARE REQUIRED TO ABIDE BY OUR DOCUMENTED CONFLICT OF INTEREST RESOLUTION WHICH REQUIRES DISCLOSURE OF ANY DUALITY OF INTEREST OR POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST. THE RESOLUTION IS SIGNED BY EACH MEMBER ANNUALLY AND IS ADDRESSED UPON THE INITIATION OF ANY NEW MEMBER. IN CONNECTION WITH ANY ACTUAL OR POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST ("COI"), AN INTERESTED PERSON MUST DISCLOSE THE EXISTENCE OF THE FINANCIAL INTEREST AND ALL MATERIAL FACTS TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OR MEMBERS OF A COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS CONSIDERING THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT. AFTER DISCLOSURE AND DISCUSSION, THE INTERESTED PERSON MUST LEAVE THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS/COMMITTEE MEETING WHILE THE DETERMINATION OF A COI IS DISCUSSED AND VOTED UPON. AFTER EXERCISING DUE DILIGENCE, THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS/COMMITTEE WILL DETERMINE WHETHER THE ORGANIZATION CAN OBTAIN, WITH REASONABLE EFFORTS, A MORE ADVANTAGEOUS TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT FROM A PERSON OR ENTITY THAT WOULD NOT GIVE RISE TO A COI. IF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS/COMMITTEE HAS REASONABLE CAUSE TO BELIEVE A MEMBER HAS FAILED TO DISCLOSE ACTUAL OR POSSIBLE CONFLICTS OF INTEREST, IT WILL INFORM THE MEMBER OF THE BASIS FOR SUCH BELIEF AND AFFORD THE MEMBER AN OPPORTUNITY TO EXPLAIN THE ALLEGED FAILURE TO DISCLOSE. DEPENDING ON THE OUTCOME, APPROPRIATE DISCIPLINARY AND CORRECTIVE ACTION MAY BE UNDERTAKEN.
